title: Better Rock
description: Adds a survival-friendly way to gain bedrock.
body:
Have you ever seen thosse clickbait videos that are like:

"NO WAY I GOT BEDROCK IN SURVIVAL!!!???"

I wanted to get bedrock in survival too so I made this mod, which makes bedrock obtainable in survival.

Obtaining

Just get a bed and some stone and craft them into bedrock.
